newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bendigo Bank sees pre-tax profit fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bendigo Bank sees pre-tax profit fall.

text.p: Bendigo Bank Ltd said on Thursday that it expected pre-tax earnings in 1996/97 from its core operations would be about 20 percent lower than last year due to competition for housing finance.
Bendigo Bank, which is regarded as a regional bank with most of its assets held in mortgages, said its after-tax profit was expected to be similar to last year.
"This is before abnormal items relating to the acquisition and restructure of Monte Paschi Australia ltd and its own operation," managing director Rob Hunt said.
Hunt said strong asset growth and the restructure would allow the bank to re-establish core profitability in 1997/98.

The upcoming annual report would show a repositioning of the balance sheet and reduced dependency on housing following the purchase of Monte Paschi and the year's trading in business and commercial finance, he said.
Bendigo said also it would release an information memorandum for a subordinated capital notes issue on Monday.
Bendigo Bank achieved 1995/96 net profit of A$12.81 million, up from A$8.96 million a year earlier. Operating profit rose to A$22.09 million from A$18.10 million.
The bank agreed to buy the Australian operations of Monte Paschi for A$42.5 million at the end of December last year.
